# Case 07: mechanism steps without a purpose

Skill: write-introductions, write-system-models
Expected gates: G-SH-Q
Language: zh

Snippet:

> 调度器先冻结队列，再使两个批次重叠，最后等待一个固定间隔后释放资源。

Why it fails: the reader cannot tell why the queue is frozen, why the batches overlap, or what the waiting interval costs.
